title: Example showcase: solar system
description: High-detail showcase of a compressed solar system: Sol, eight planets, Pluto, major moons, Saturn/Uranus rings, asteroid + Kuiper belts, a Halley-class comet, and a keyboard free-fly camera (WASD / QE / mouse). Distances and radii are artistic — not to scale — so you can read surfaces, atmospheres, and ring structure while flying. Playback drives orbital time; pause freezes the clock but not the craft.

attribution.author: igoakulov
attribution.prompt: Make a flashy high-detail solar system where I can fly with keyboard. Go all out.
